const s=ctx.state,gl=ctx.gl;s.canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(1,1);s.c=s.canvas.getContext('2d');s.texture=gl.createTexture();s.program=ctx.utils.createProgram(ctx.utils.FULLSCREEN_VERTEX_SHADER,`#version 300 es
precision highp float;in vec2 v_uv;out vec4 outColor;uniform sampler2D u_image;void main(){outColor=texture(u_image,vec2(v_uv.x,1.-v_uv.y));}`);s.mount=()=>{const div=document.createElement('div');div.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:512px;height:512px;overflow:hidden';document.body.appendChild(div);return div;};s.colors=['#57d8c6','#ffbc78','#ad9bff'];const core=await ctx.utils.import('https://esm.sh/deck.gl@9.4.0?bundle&deps=react@19.3.0,react-dom@19.3.0');const layers=core;s.core=core;s.layers=layers;s.div=s.mount();s.surface=document.createElement('canvas');s.div.appendChild(s.surface);s.surface.width=512;s.surface.height=512;s.blocks=Array.from({length:30},(_,i)=>{const x=i%6,y=Math.floor(i/6),lon=126.953+x*.008,lat=37.547+y*.008;return {type:'Feature',properties:{group:(x+y)%3,height:100+((i*17)%8)*100},geometry:{type:'Polygon',coordinates:[[[lon,lat],[lon+.006,lat],[lon+.006,lat+.006],[lon,lat+.006],[lon,lat]]]}};});s.geojson={type:'FeatureCollection',features:s.blocks};s.layer=height=>new layers.PolygonLayer({id:'blocks',data:s.blocks,getPolygon:d=>d.geometry.coordinates[0],getElevation:d=>d.properties.height*height,getFillColor:d=>[[87,216,198],[255,188,120],[173,155,255]][d.properties.group],getLineColor:[24,46,58],lineWidthMinPixels:1,extruded:true,wireframe:true,pickable:false});await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{s.deck=new core.Deck({canvas:s.surface,width:512,height:512,views:[new core.MapView()],viewState:{longitude:126.978,latitude:37.5665,zoom:12,pitch:45,bearing:20},controller:false,layers:[s.layer(1)],deviceProps:{webgl:{preserveDrawingBuffer:true}},onLoad:resolve,onError:e=>{s.error=String(e);reject(e);}});});
